lunar surface Apollo 11.title: View of footpad of Apollo 11 Lunar Module as it rested on lunar surface
lunar surface Apollo 11.description: A close-up view of a footpad of the Apollo 11 Lunar Module as it rested on the surface of the Moon. The stick-like protruding object is a lunar surface sensing probe. This photograph was take with a 70mm lunar surface camera during the extravehicular activity of Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Edwin Aldrin on July 20, 1969.

lunar surface Apollo 11.title: Apollo 11 lunar surface panoramic views
lunar surface Apollo 11.description: S69-44463 (July 1969) --- Astronaut Neil A. Armstrong took this series of pictures of the landing site of Apollo 11's Lunar Module (LM) Eagle on the lunar surface.  These panoramic views of the lunar surface reveal the surface near where the LM touched down, in the southeastern Sea of Tranquility.  Foot pads and shadows of the LM are visible in the two of the three panoramic views.
